panels.title: Readings stored

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and r._field == "quality" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.description: Readings in InfluxDB for the selected time range, by reading time.

panels.title: Chunks missing (gaps)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gap" and r._field == "chunks" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.description: Chunks the gateway evicted before they could be sent (seq gaps detected by server-sim).

panels.title: Readings not GOOD

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and r._field == "quality" and r._value != "GOOD" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.description: Readings whose quality is not GOOD (TIMEOUT, CRC_ERROR, DEVICE_OFFLINE, INVALID).

panels.title: Values

targets.query:
import "join"
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "datapoint_meta")
  |> group(columns: ["gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id", "name", "unit"])
// join.left fails on an empty right side, so there is always one row that matches nothing.
meta = union(tables: [named, array.from(rows: [{gateway_id: "", device_id: "", datapoint_id: "", name: "", unit: ""}])])
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and r._field == "value" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> join.left(right: meta, on: (l, r) => l.gateway_id == r.gateway_id and l.device_id == r.device_id and l.datapoint_id == r.datapoint_id,
       as: (l, r) => ({_time: l._time, _value: l._value, gateway_id: l.gateway_id,
         series: l.gateway_id + " · " + (if exists r.name and r.name != "" then r.name else "dev " + l.device_id + " / dp " + l.datapoint_id)
           + (if exists r.unit and r.unit != "" then " (" + r.unit + ")" else "")}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.description: Mean per interval. Series are labelled with the name and unit set on the server-sim Datapoints page.

panels.title: Readings per minute

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and r._field == "quality" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["gateway_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "gateway_id"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "readings/min"})

panels.description: Readings received per minute, by reading time. A dip means the gateway sent less (or has not sent the backlog yet).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and r._field == "quality" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, quality: r._value, n: 1}))
  |> group(columns: ["quality"])
  |> sum(column: "n")
  |> rename(columns: {n: "_value"})

import "join"
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "datapoint_meta")
  |> group(columns: ["gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id", "name", "unit"])
meta = union(tables: [named, array.from(rows: [{gateway_id: "", device_id: "", datapoint_id: "", name: "", unit: ""}])])
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "quality") and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> join.left(right: meta, on: (l, r) => l.gateway_id == r.gateway_id and l.device_id == r.device_id and l.datapoint_id == r.datapoint_id,
       as: (l, r) => ({Gateway: l.gateway_id, Device: l.device_id, Datapoint: l.datapoint_id,
         Name: if exists r.name then r.name else "", Value: l.value, Unit: if exists r.unit then r.unit else "",
         Quality: l.quality, Time: l._time}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Gateway", "Device", "Datapoint"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gap" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "gateway_id", "from_seq", "to_seq", "chunks", "stream_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reading" and r._field == "quality" and r._value != "GOOD" and r.gateway_id =~ /^${gateway:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "gateway_id", "device_id", "datapoint_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "quality"})
